title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode5 The Issue With Crawl Green

meta.Episode: Episode5 — The Issue With Crawl Green
meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Ah, Shinonome, see you next time.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I did okay during today's event, but I'm still nowhere near the level of RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I've learned to sing high notes better and how to get the crowd going.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I have to run more to make sure I have stamina for the second half, and...)

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: I told you about him before. He's Akito Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician B
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember. You said you're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND or whatever, right?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician C
rows.Line:
Talk about a pipe dream.
There's no way someone like you is ever going to do that.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I don't care who says what to me, and I know that it's not gonna be easy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Just watch. I'll overtake wimps like you who put down everyone around them because they don't want to aim higher.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: If you're willing to say that much, then come perform at the event at Crawl Green next week.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Crawl Green...?
Isn't that where RADder debuted...?!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Yeah, and we've got some serious players lined up. We decided to invite you since you've been showing some signs of improvement lately.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: You're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, right? If so, this event should be a piece of cake for you. Don't tell us that you're gonna turn tail and run?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I know better than anyone what I'm capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (So, I know full well that I'm not ready to perform there yet. But...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I've made my decision. I'm devoting my life to music!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(No, what am I doing?
I need to sing louder!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(No, my voice is so shaky...
This is the best part of the chorus. I have to nail it...!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have much time left until the show next week... At the place where RADder began...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I've been wanting to play there forever! I have to put on the best performance I possibly can!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I don't care if it takes up all of my time. I'm going to do everything I can for it...!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... *Cough*
No, I'm starting to lose my voice... What am I doing? This won't be enough...!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Junior high schooler or not, RAD WEEKEND is the stuff of legends.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: So quit playing around. I hate it when people talk about surpassing it like it's no big deal.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Who do they think they are saying all these things about me... Argh...!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No! Why can't I get it right?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Okay, that was better than before...
But I need to find a way to sing with more power.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (It's getting pretty late, but she's still practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(No, it's not just her...
A lot of other people are still singing, and they all look really serious...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (They're all struggling and doing everything they can to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Which means I need to keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line:
You really came.
We honestly thought you'd bail.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: Since you're here, you should see the others' performances. It should give you a taste of what you're up against.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I still have a lot of time until it's my turn...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I'll probably go stir-crazy if I stay backstage, so maybe I should see some of their performances...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, they've got the crowd going totally wild...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Those guys have been performing everywhere lately. Didn't they headline a different event just the other day?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But they're nothing special in the eyes of this place. If only some real talent could show up.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (You've gotta be kidding me. They're not good enough...?!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(So this is Crawl Green...
The venue where RADder began...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: They're all on a totally different level...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: It'll be my turn in fifteen minutes...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Come on. I don't have time to feel scared. I practiced a ton for this, didn't I...?!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (And I get that it's way too soon for me to be performing here.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(But none of that matters now.
I just have to give it everything I have...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Next is... Akito Shinonome. Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
You're still in junior high?
That's incredible. And you're already performing here?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: I only heard this just a second ago, but you filled in for someone who couldn't make it today?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
This is your mic.
We'll be looking forward to your performance.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I can't get a good grip. My fingers are shaking too much... But... I've gotta do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (This is where I've been wanting to perform! I've been practicing every day just for this! This crowd won't know what hit them...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I've never seen him before. This should be good...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: He looks like he's still in junior high. He must be pretty good if he's been asked to perform here.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What if he's like RADder? How awesome would it be to see another legendary performer make their debut here?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Geez, my voice... I'm getting really nervous... I might not be able to sing at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (No, I'll be fine. I practiced as much as I did just for this moment.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I worked as hard as I could in this city to get here...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (They're making everything shake like crazy...! I never knew that a musician could make so many people go wild like this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (It's like a tsunami of notes is hitting us all at once...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I don't want to regret doing this! I want to do something worthy of this legendary place! So... I have to give it everything I've got!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(They're starting to lose interest...
No, I've gotta turn this around...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Don't believe the hype, I guess...?
He's just a kid. Who invited him here?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(I'm not running...
The show has to go on until the very end.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Finally, he's done.
The others are waiting outside. We should let them know.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, since those guys are up next!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: The wait's over, everyone! Where'd all that energy from before go?! Actually, I can't really blame you after what you guys just saw.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician A
rows.Line: We're gonna wipe that from your memories by going all out with our first song! Get ready to make some noise!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (The crowd warmed up the second they started singing...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (How much more do I have to practice to be able to sing like them...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I saw so many other people perform here today, and they're all better than me...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Why am I not able to sing like them?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (After going on and on about taking this seriously and devoting my life to music too... But I couldn't do anything in the end. If anything, I...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I dragged the name of a legendary venue through the mud...)
